entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling because I'd like to return an Aero Road Helmet I purchased recently.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order, delivered 24 days ago. So I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference issue. The online pictures made the color seem like a brighter red, but it's more of a maroon. I haven't even taken it out; the box is still unopened.

I understand completely. Sometimes the lighting in photos can be tricky. Let me just confirm the return policy for this item... Yes, it looks like you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can process this for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, that's great news. So what are the next steps?

I've just approved the return on my end. You'll get an email shortly with a pre-paid return label. Just print that out, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off. It's a very simple process.

Excellent, I appreciate that. Now, I do plan on ordering a different helmet, likely today. Since I'm going through the hassle of this return process, is there any possibility of a small discount code I could use on the new purchase?

That's a fair question. Let me check your account... I see you're a VIP member with us, and we definitely want to ensure you have the gear you love, especially when it comes to safety. For the inconvenience, I can offer you a 15% discount code for your next order. How does that sound?
A 15% discount would be perfect. That's very helpful, thank you.

You're very welcome. I've sent that code to you in a separate email. Once we receive the returned helmet, you can expect the refund to your original payment method in 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's all. You've solved my problem. Thanks again, David.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
